summary: Iteration 5 (IMAP sync) validated end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases in test_iter5.py pass — POST /api/smtp/{id}/sync-imap returns 400 for accounts without imap_host, 400 with 'Falha IMAP' for unreachable host (persisting imap_status='error'), 404 for unknown id, 400 for bad id, 401/403 unauth; IMAP fields (imap_host/port/username) are persisted; imap_password_enc and password_enc are NEVER exposed on POST/PUT/GET /api/smtp. Regression: existing backend_test.py 46/46 pass. Frontend: UI creation with IMAP section works (imap-host/port/username/password inputs), 'Sincronizar' button (sync-imap-*) appears ONLY on cards with imap_host and NOT on accounts without IMAP; clicking triggers POST /api/smtp/{id}/sync-imap (returns 400 as expected in preview env without real IMAP server) and shows a toast; navigation regression across /contactos, /grupos, /templates, /campanhas, /estatisticas, /configuracoes OK; Dashboard renders 'Respostas' stat card (verified in Dashboard.jsx source).
critical_code_review_comments: imap_sync.sync_account: correctly falls back to SMTP username/password when imap_username/imap_password are empty (Gmail App-Password friendly).

imap_sync._mark_reply: idempotent — updates contact.status='respondido', marks matching job replied+status='replied', and cancels ALL remaining pending jobs for that contact with a Portuguese reason string. Good.
imap_sync._extract_message_ids: normalizes with and without angle brackets — matches both storage formats. Good.

api.sync_imap: converts imap_status='error' to HTTP 400 with the underlying imap_error string — leaks internal exception text; consider a generic message for user-facing detail while still logging the raw error server-side.
worker.start_scheduler: adds sync_all_accounts on 180s interval — matches spec.
api.serialize strips password_enc and imap_password_enc unconditionally — verified in tests. Never leaks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on iteration 5 IMAP UI flow + navigation regression

seed_data_creation: test_iter5.py creates TEST_iter5_noimap and TEST_iter5_withimap SMTP accounts and cleans them on teardown. UI test created + deleted TEST_ui_iter5_imap via the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview env has no real IMAP server — expect POST /api/smtp/{id}/sync-imap with any real host to return 400 with imap_status persisted as 'error'. To simulate successful reply detection, seed a contact + email_jobs.message_id and invoke sync_account with a mocked imap fetch (as previously done locally). All new suites run serially (-n 0). Regression suite (backend_test.py) also requires -n 0 due to class-shared state.
